parts.text: A student investigates the refraction of light in a transparent block. Fig. 2.1 shows her ray-trace sheet. She places a transparent block on the ray-trace sheet and draws the outline ABCD of the block. The student uses pins to mark the positions of objects and images. Fig. 2.1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) • On Fig. 2.1, draw the normal NL at the centre of side AB . Continue the normal NL so that it passes through side CD of the block. • Label the point F where the normal NL crosses side AB . • Label the point G where the normal NL crosses side CD . [1]

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:
normal in centre of AB to 2 mm and at 90°
and F and G correctly labelled

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) • On Fig. 2.1, draw a line EF at least 7 cm long above side AB and at an angle i = 30° to the left of the normal. Label the end of the line E . • Mark the positions of two pins P 1 and P 2 , to act as objects, on line EF at a suitable distance apart for this type of ray-trace experiment. [1]

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text: P1P2 pin separation at least 5.0 cm

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) • The student looks from the position of the eye shown in Fig. 2.1, to observe the images of P 1 and P 2 through side CD of the block. She adjusts her line of sight until the images of P 1 and P 2 appear one behind the other. • She places two pins P 3 and P 4 between her eye and the block so that P 3 , P 4 and the images of P 1 and P 2 , seen through the block, appear one behind the other. • The positions of P 3 and P 4 are marked on the ray-trace sheet.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Continue the line through the block until it extends to just outside the outline of the block. Label this end of the line K . [1]

ms.label: 2(c)(i)
ms.text:
line through P3 and P4 correctly drawn and its end
labelled K

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) • Label the point H where the line in (c)(i) meets side CD . • Label the point J where the line meets the normal NL . • Draw the line FH . [1]

ms.label: 2(c)(ii)
ms.text: points H and J correctly labelled, and FH correctly drawn

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Measure and record the acute angle θ between the line JF and the line JK . An acute angle is less than 90°. θ = ......................................................... [2]

ms.label: 2(e)
ms.text:
any one from:
thin lines / pins / sharp pencil
view bases of pins
ensure pins vertical / perpendicular to ray trace sheet
use large pin separation
(securely) attach the ray trace sheet to the surface

parts.label: f
parts.text: (f) A student suggests that i should be equal to θ within the limits of experimental accuracy. In this experiment, i = 30°. Suggest a range of values for θ that match this suggestion for the experiment. range .................................................................................................................................. [1]

ms.label: 2(g)
ms.text:
repeat experiment using more i values
uses at least 4 i values
